about_short_description.short_description: Datacultr is the Global OS for Risk Management & Debt Collections for High Risk Lending, reduces defaults & NPAs

product.name: Digital Debt Collection Platform
product.description: A digital platform that automates and enhances debt collection processes by engaging borrowers directly through their devices to improve collection efficiency and reduce non-performing loans.

product.name: Device Lock Solutions
product.description: Technology that remotely locks financed devices like smartphones, tablets, and smart TVs to enforce payment compliance and reduce defaults in device financing.

product.name: Digital Promise To Pay
product.description: A digital workflow tool that enables lenders to engage defaulters directly on their devices to create actionable repayment plans without relying on call agents.

product.name: Digital Legal Notice
product.description: A platform to send authenticated legal notices digitally to borrowers’ devices with guaranteed delivery and instant acknowledgment, reducing costs and improving response rates.

product.name: OEM Partnership Device Affordability Programs
product.description: A device locking and financing platform integrated at the OS level to support smartphone OEMs in expanding financing schemes and partnerships with financiers and telecom operators.
